department: School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE)

deadline.value: August 2027 intake deadline is January 31, 2027 (application portal opens October 1; January intake deadline is July 31).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for mechanical or aerospace engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must list preferred supervisors on the application and are strongly encouraged to contact potential supervisors before submitting.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are required to indicate their preferred supervisors in the application. Candidates are strongly encouraged to contact potential supervisors in advance before submitting their application.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a strong bachelor's degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: 1. Bachelor’s Degree: A strong Bachelor’s degree with minimum Honours (Distinction) and its equivalent.

notes: Covers Mechanical Engineering and Aerospace Engineering PhD research areas (also includes Robotics & Intelligent Systems and Biomedical Engineering tracks).
